findings.failureScenario: parse_xmp computes m.iso at line 511 with a >0 filter and an exifEX:PhotographicSensitivity fallback, then lines 512-514 unconditionally overwrite it with the unfiltered exif:ISOSpeedRatings value (parse_number already trims, so the override adds nothing but bypassing the filter). An XMP packet with exif:ISOSpeedRatings 0 (or a negative value) and a valid exifEX:PhotographicSensitivity of 6400 yields iso = Some(0) instead of 6400; a negative value saturates to Some(0) via `as u32`.
findings.action: Delete the override at lines 512-514 (line 511 already reads exif:ISOSpeedRatings first), or apply the same >0 filter and fallback there.

findings.failureScenario: render_photo always renders to a temporary .png and image_result re-encodes only when `format` is jpeg; it then writes those bytes to the caller's `path` without consulting the path's extension. An agent calling render_photo {path: "/tmp/look.jpg"} with no `format` gets PNG bytes saved under a .jpg name (screenshot behaves the same), while the headless app.export and ui.render paths pick the encoder from the extension.
findings.action: When `path` is given and `format` is absent, derive the encoding from the path extension (as Headless::export and write_image do), or reject a path whose extension disagrees with the chosen format.
